Detailed Description

Subclasses of this collect samples into a Buffer and transmit it to BufferReceiver objects.

This mechanism is used by the ScopeGUI class and the Sender UGen to display time-domain sample data. The FFTSender UGen collects buffers and sends FFT-transformed buffers (e.g., to a ScopeGUI) for dealing with spectral data. But they can be used for other purposes too.
